hook: Will the new US-Russia diesel agreement between Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin actually change your life?

sections.voiceover: Will the new US-Russia diesel agreement between Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin actually change your life?
b_roll: Split screen showing US gas station and Russian oil tanker

sections.voiceover: Why would this deal fail to lower fuel prices for the United States before April 1, 2027?
b_roll: Map showing flow of oil from Russia to the US
Close up of gas price sign

sections.voiceover: The Guardian reports that the limited volume of Russian diesel won't shift global fuel prices.
b_roll: Graphic showing a tiny drop of oil against a large US flag

sections.voiceover: Long shipping times prevent this deal from lowering fuel costs for the United States today. KSE Institute data confirms that global energy flow disruptions undermine the effectiveness of these sanctions.
b_roll: Bar chart comparing energy flow disruptions
Driver filling up at a pump

sections.voiceover: Sanctions stay suspended until April 1, 2027, despite these limited impacts on the fuel market.
